state_metric_meta.child_note: Children under 18 = Census PEP under-18 age-share (2013) scaled to 2025 state totals; national total normalized to ~72.3M (US under-18, 2024 est.); directional.

metro_meta.note: Metros = TAA providers clustered to the nearest major-city anchor within 50 miles (top-1000 US cities by population). Core pop = the anchor city's Census population (NOT full MSA population — official MSA delineations were not reachable in this build). Provider and CoE counts are exact.
